transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose my mind just feels foggy lately. I work at the library, and I just... I can't even seem to keep my place in my old cataloguing notes. Or even decide what simple thing to do next. So... that's why I came in.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

I suppose... I don't know if sad is the right word. But... well, most days lately I just end up sitting at the kitchen table. It just seems like... like the color has gone out of everything. I try to look at my old watercolor books, but... they don't interest me right now. They just make me feel... heavy, I guess.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you normally like to do?
No... not really. Like I said about the painting... I just don't care for it right now. There isn't really much else I do anyway, so... I don't know. I suppose not.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
No... I wouldn't say anxious. I don't really have the energy to be on edge. I mostly just feel... well, like I said before. So, no. I don't think so.
How long have you been feeling this way?

I don't know... maybe three months? Give or take. It's been most days. I suppose it started around the time I began getting things ready to leave my job at the library. Just... foggy since then, I guess.
Have you noticed any change in your weight lately?

I suppose... maybe a little. I don't really weigh myself, so I don't know the numbers. But I kind of have to remind myself to eat lately. My wife, she... well, she notices I leave things like rice and soup half-finished. I never used to waste a meal before. Just... don't have much of an appetite, I guess.
Do you feel guilty about anything lately?
Guilty? ...No, I don't think so. I haven't really been doing much of anything lately, so... there's not much to feel guilty about, I suppose. Just... no. Not really.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?
Not really. I don't know. I used to like reading, but... I just haven't felt like picking up a book lately. Nothing really seems all that interesting right now.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide lately?
No. I haven't... no. Just feeling tired of things, but I don't think about... that. No.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt somewhat better than others?
Not really. Um... it all just kind of blends together. I haven't noticed any days standing out. Just... more of the same, I guess.
Are there any things that you used to enjoy doing, but now find you no longer take pleasure in?
Well... just the reading, like I mentioned a minute ago. I can't really think of anything else. I mostly just go to work and come home... I don't really do much.
Do you feel your symptoms are interfering with your daily life most of the time?

I suppose... yeah. Things just kind of pile up lately. Um... like lecture plans, or travel notes. Even just the regular household paperwork. I just... I can't seem to organize myself the way I used to. So... yes, I guess it does.
Would you say that your feelings of being foggy and disinterested are mild, or are they quite overwhelming most of the time?

I don't know if overwhelming is the right word. It's just... always there. Moderate, maybe? It's enough to slow me down, but I still get up and go to work. So... not overwhelming, I guess. Just... a constant fog.
Would you say your symptoms are affecting your ability to work or take care of things at home most of the time, or is it more like some of the time?

Well... like I was saying a minute ago, it's probably most of the time. I just... I let things pile up. The lecture plans, the travel notes... even the simple household paperwork. I just can't get myself organized reliably anymore. So... yeah. Most of the time.
Would you say that most days you have little to no interest in doing things, or is it more like you have some interest but just can't seem to get started?

I guess... it's more like little to no interest. Most days lately, I just sit at the kitchen table and... I don't know. It's hard to explain. It just feels like the color has gone out of everything. I have these old watercolor books I used to like, but... looking at them now just makes me feel heavy. I just don't care to do it.
Would you say that your lack of interest in activities is something that you experience nearly every day?
I suppose so... yeah. Pretty much every day now.
Would you say that your symptoms are causing significant distress or impairment in your daily life?

Yeah, I guess so. Like I mentioned before... I'm just letting everything pile up. The lecture plans, the travel notes... the household paperwork. I just... I can't organize myself the way I used to. So, yes... it's causing problems.
Would you say that your symptoms are interfering with your daily life to the point where you're unable to function at all, or are you still able to manage your daily tasks with some difficulty?

I'm not... completely unable to function, I guess. I still get up. But... well, like I just said about the lecture plans and the household paperwork. It's all just sitting there. I just can't reliably organize myself anymore. So... I suppose I'm managing, but it's... it's difficult.
Would you say that your symptoms are making it very difficult for you to carry out even simple daily activities?
Yes. Like I just said... even the simple household paperwork. It just piles up. I can't seem to organize myself to get it done anymore.
Would you say that your symptoms are making it hard for you to find any pleasure in things most of the time?

I suppose so. Most days lately, I just sit at the kitchen table... and it feels like the color has gone out of everything. Even my old watercolor books... they don't interest me anymore. They just make me feel heavy. So, yes.
